newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares mark time, watch dollar.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares mark time, watch dollar.

text.p: Shares marked time and traders said the trend on Tuesday would depend heavily on how the dollar performs. If the U.S. currency gains, then shares will probably gain, they said.

"Tomorrow, everything is going to depend on the dollar," said one trader, adding that the U.S. currency's slight weakness on Monday had no impact as traders were still unclear of the direction it would take.

Total share turnover was a modest 1.9 billion escudos, with activity in Portugal Telecom dominating. Traders said that business in the telecom stock, which was heavily concentrated in the morning, was triggered by Friday's firmer close in New York.
The share closed 0.14 percent higher at 4,150 escudos.
Banco Comercial Portugues edged closer towards the 2,000 escudos that some analysts have predicted. It closed 0.36 percent higher at 1,970.
